title: guarea tuberculata var. purgans
intro: Guarea tuberculata var. purgans, commonly known as West Indian satinwood, is a plant species belonging to the family Meliaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include treating various health issues such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems. The health benefits of West Indian satinwood are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic activities, achieved through its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents present in this plant contribute to its medicinal properties, making it a potential source for the development of new pharmaceuticals and traditional remedies.
